items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury. Optimistic reports confirmed; feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Schefter primary report; ETR had GTD/optimism; Berry confirmed active.
items.implication: Must-start WR1; full projection restored. Late window backup still advised pre-confirm.
items.opportunity: Elite target share expected if no setback.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall inactive today. Was GTD/pessimism; limited practice, early return attempt failed.
items.why: Schefter actives/inactives list; Rapoport earlier unlikely; ETR GTD/pessimism.
items.implication: Fourth missed game; Braelon Allen lead role continues in good matchup vs MIA.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially OUT for Week 7. Projections updated accordingly; Ravens offense impacted without him.
items.why: ETR weekend summary and multiple corroborations; high ankle sprain, third straight miss.
items.implication: Start Huntley or stream elsewhere; Flowers/Andrews downgraded without Lamar.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) for Monday vs DAL. Top WR sidelined.
items.why: ETR OUT list; beat reports confirmed no practice, ruled out.
items.implication: Major target vacuum; Goedert/others elevated. Berry had loved pre-OUT.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining WRs/TE; Saquon if active.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected lead RB and produced 124/17/1 but Levitan thinks actually hurt (hamstring) though not certain. Tracy also hamstring watch.
items.why: Rapoport expected lead + production; Levitan post-game suspicion on ETR watch.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; strong outing but injury cloud.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; Levitan says almost certainly fine. Would have been tilting if real injury avoiding TD.
items.why: Levitan direct on ETR injury watch post; purposeful slide context.
items.implication: No downgrade expected; continue as RB1.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to locker room (quad) then returned to game. ETR watching but returned.
items.why: Schefter updates; ETR post-game watch list.
items.implication: Continue monitoring but played through; no immediate long-term flag.

items.text: All ETR projections fully updated for latest statuses (Lamar/Puka/Breece crucial). Sims favor certain underowned spots.
items.why: Direct response to ETR injury summary; player-specific adjustments.
items.implication: Trust latest for start/sit/DFS; value on projected but low-owned.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play after layoff. Listed in ETR IN group.
items.why: ETR summary; Schefter activations expected to play.
items.implication: Workload question post-layoff; monitor snap share vs DET.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if full go.
items.conflict: Berry HATE due to rust/workload uncertainty.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs DAL after hamstring. Questionable but positive.
items.why: ETR summary; full practice Saturday; Berry notes in line to play.
items.implication: RB1 upside in great matchup if active; Eagles depleted at WR elevates need.

items.text: Eagles WR Dontayvion Wicks OUT (ankle) alongside Smith. Top two WRs missing Monday.
items.why: ETR paired with Smith OUT; official ruling.
items.implication: Extreme pass-catcher scarcity for PHI; streamers/Goedert surge.
items.opportunity: High target share for available receivers/TE.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell among actives/activated expected to play. ETR IN list.
items.implication: WR depth boost for HOU; target competition.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES A.J. Brown @ CHI (usage/matchup). Back in real role vs soft Bears defense.
items.why: Elite volume/matchup; Bears good for yardage.

items.text: Berry LOVES Tucker Kraft @ DET as TE buffet. Lions allow tons of TE production (9 TDs in 5 games).
Berry LOVES volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Consistent volume + defenses carved by RBs.
items.implication: RB2/flex locks with path to more.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze vs NE due to Christian Gonzalez shadow; 90% outside targets, limited production history.
Berry HATES Josh Jacobs @ DET post-layoff; workload questions after long absence.
items.why: Rust and possible committee after IR return.
items.implication: Cautious start despite activation; monitor snaps.

items.text: Berry HATES Cam Skattebo @ HOU pregame (brutal spot); later produced as lead but Levitan injury concern.
items.why: Tough matchup and role uncertainty pregame.
items.implication: Fade was wrong on production; now watch injury.
items.conflict: Strong stats vs pregame hate; post-game hurt signal.
